$comment: Registry of models this machine can delegate to.
transport 'ollama'   -> native Ollama /api/chat. Deterministic, no tools,
returns text or strict JSON. Best for generation.
transport 'opencode' -> OpenCode session API. Agentic: the model gets
tools and edits files itself inside ITS workspace.
Health of every target:  delegate.py health

coder.notes: RTX 5070 Ti, this machine. Loopback only - see README 'LAN exposure'. num_ctx is what is actually requested; context_tokens is the model maximum. Was 32k; lowered to 16k after the container restarted with the GPU at 15.8/16.3 GB (cause unconfirmed).
bad_for: intricate parsing (4/10 on the diff_lines bake-off)

small.notes: GTX 1070. num_ctx 12288 is the largest that stays 100% in VRAM; above it the model spills to CPU. context_tokens is the model maximum, not what is requested.

oc-coder.notes: Agentic. Edits files in the OpenCode server's own workspace, NOT this repo. WARNING: via OpenCode's /v1 endpoint num_ctx can't be sent, so the server default (4096) applies and OpenCode's scaffold gets truncated. Fix with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH on the Ollama server.
bad_for: anything you want landed directly in this working tree

oc-small.notes: Agentic on the GTX 1070. Agent scaffolding alone costs ~2.4k tokens of its 41k window, so keep briefs short. WARNING: via OpenCode's /v1 endpoint num_ctx can't be sent, so the server default (4096) applies and OpenCode's scaffold gets truncated. Fix with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH on the Ollama server.
bad_for: anything needing sustained context or multi-file reasoning

gpt-build.notes: gpt-6-sol. The workhorse: all building. diff_lines bake-off 10/10 on both runs of the corrected brief (and handled the ambiguous original the way git works). ~16-27s.

gemini-review.notes: Second-opinion reviewer for large features. Different family from the builder.
gemini-review.disabled: free tier has no quota for gemini-3.1-pro-preview (quota exceeded on first call)

cerebras-fast.notes: Very fast inference. Scaffolding and quick second opinions.
cerebras-fast.disabled: ContextOverflowError on every call: OpenCode's ~6-9k token agent scaffold exceeds the free tier's context

claude-review.notes: Final reviewer for large or risky features only. Paid per token; the orchestrator is Claude Code itself, not this.
claude-review.disabled: OpenCode's Anthropic key is rejected: 'invalid x-api-key'. Re-enter it on the OpenCode host, then remove this line

gemini-flash.notes: Verified 2026-09-28. Free tier, rate-limited. Scaffolding and cross-family second opinions.

gpt-fast.notes: gpt-6-luna. Fast (~10s) but less reliable on intricate code: with the corrected diff_lines brief it scored 9/10 then 8/10, missing a different real case each run. Scaffolding and small test files only.

cerebras-direct.notes: Direct API. Planted-bug review: 3/3 in 1.2s, free. gpt-oss is OpenAI's open-weights model, so it shares lineage with the builder: always pair it with a non-OpenAI reviewer.

gemini-direct.notes: Direct endpoint works (PONG in 4.9s, 157 tokens vs 8,868 via OpenCode), but returned HTTP 503 on 3 review attempts in a row. Not routed until it's reliable.

claude-direct.notes: Direct Messages API, paid. Planted-bug review: 3/3 in 16s, clearest explanations. Primary reviewer for large or risky changes.

$comment: role -> size -> {primary, second}. OpenAI (subscription) carries the workload: build, scaffold, tests.
Review never uses the builder's family (enforced). cerebras-direct is gpt-oss (OpenAI open weights),
so each review route also includes a different lineage: coder (Qwen) or claude-direct (Anthropic).
Orchestrator is Claude Code (this window); it is not a route.
